:::{#exr-sample-factorization}
#### The joint mass function of an exponential family sample factors through the sum of the statistic

Let $\dsn{X} \siid \pdf\paren{\rvar ; \natparam}$ be a sample of a
[discrete random variable](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-discrete-rv)
whose [probability mass function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-pmf)
has the form of @eq-exponential-family.
Show that the joint mass function of the sample is

$$
\pdf\paren{\vx ; \natparam}
= \expf{\natparam \sumin \statf{\rvar_\iobs} - n \, \logpartitionf{\natparam}}
\prod_{i=1}^n \basemeasuref{\rvar_\iobs}.
$$

:::
